title: Shared primitives
description: Formats used across artifact and event schemas. Money is a decimal string, never a JSON number: a ledger compared against a hard ceiling cannot be carried in a type that loses cents.

UsdAmount.description: Decimal string. Negative values are invalid for costs but the pattern permits them so that a delta can reuse this type.

SchemaVersion.description: Major.minor. A consumer reading an unknown major version MUST fail loudly rather than proceed.

WorkspacePath.description: Workspace-relative POSIX path. Absolute paths and backslashes are rejected; traversal is rejected by the host-side validator after symlink resolution.

Argv.description: An argument vector. Never a shell string: a string interface invites interpolation.

State.description: MUST equal the state list in contracts/state-machine.json and the CHECK constraint in contracts/db/0001_init.sql.

VerificationOutcome.description: The only three outcomes. 'not_verified' means the command did not run to completion and MUST NOT be rendered as either success or failure.
